Why Kickstarter matters to us right now

While the core game will be made either way, your support means we can do so much more. It allows us to:

This kickstarter could give us the ressources to have our team full time on this, allowing us to bring the game quicker to you.

Kickstarter would also provides undeniable proof that people are excited about our idea.  This "proof of interest" is our strongest asset when applying for public funding or speaking to investors. It transforms us from "a team with a dream" to "a team with a proven, supported vision." Think of this not just as a purchase, but as a vote of confidence. 

We decided to launch during this early production phase because we might never have an opportunity to have so much visibility through steam's horse game fevstial, and during this phase we can change the scope and ambition of the game thanks do your support. So we thought we'd give it a try, it's never the right moment so sometimes you just gotta go for it !


Key Features

 Horses of Gavarnie is a 3D Narrative Adventure about raising horses in the rustic Pyrenees. You manage a ranch, build a community, and guide both humans and horses through a changing world where you pair horses up with their forever homes.

Breeding & Matchmaking: Breed horses for villagers and yourself to match them with the right horse for their needs, helping the community thrive.

Festival Participation: Take part in local festivals to showcase working horses in challenges and games such has sheep hearding and your classic jumps and races.

Creature Discovery: Encounter imaginary creatures inspired by local French fauna.

Horse Collection: Discover and collect new horse types and coat colors.

Twin Horse Leading: Ride your main mount while leading a second horse to carry belongings or deliver it to a new home.

You play as Arabelle, a woman from Béarn, whose life is deeply connected to nature, her neighbors, and the stories of the land. Every chapter brings new challenges, adventures, and opportunitiesfor you and your horses, help your community, and uncover the magic hidden in the mountains.

Whether you’re exploring, breeding, or building friendships, Horses of Gavarnie is a cozy, magical journey where discovery, care and connection come first.


Where we're at

Think of it like we've got all the blueprints approved, the concept art is on the walls. The Foundation is Built: story, and art direction are designed and approved. Core mechanics such as riding, character controls and camera, dialog, and horse genetics exist. We know how the game works, what the story is, and what it should look like. No more guessing. 

!all clips below are placeholder characters and assets, we are replacing gradually everything with out own hand made 3D art and it takes time!

Reproduction and foal growing up test, very raw, very ugly please bare with us

Playable Prototypes Exist, we have key "bits of gameplay" that need to be assembled together. Art, environments, and menus are getting made weekly. It’s slowly looking less like a tech demo. Our main job now is to mare more prototype chunks and test them even more  assembling them together with the art. This means a ton of bug fixing, making sure systems talk to each other, and optimizing so it runs smooth. 

We’ll launch into Early Access once this assembling, also called Pre production phase is done and we have something that’s fun, stable, and ready for you to break and give us notes on.

About the Game

Horses of Gavarnie is a third-person narrative driven game set in a fantasy world inspired by the Pyrenees, where you manage a ranch, build a community, and adapt to industrialization. Discover and create new horse breeds, lead a second horse by your side as you ride, and help both horses and humans find their perfect match.

You play as Arabelle, a bearneese woman with many stories, and you must manage this farm dedicated to raising horses. However, your role goes beyond your small farm; mutual help and solidarity are important here, making you a pillar of the community. You will help both horses and humans find their perfect life partners in these rustic mountains, while learning how to live with constant progress that changes the balance of their home. If you look closely, you might even spot mystical creatures like the «dahu »...

A French Wild West, where horses are not just resources but true companions. You will help the locals improve their quality of life, as well as that of the other creatures. You can also customize and welcome more residents, all without the concept of money. It is possible to move around with your main mount and a second horse by your side , which will follow you and carry your belongings. A breeding system allows you to discover new coat colors and breeds, helping you complete the “book of colors”, like a collectibles album.
